items.prompt: What may be used to set historical earlier VWAP-style schedule weights without look-ahead?

options.text: A volume forecast available at planning time
options.why: The forecast still has uncertainty and is not a realized fill guarantee.

options.text: Realized full-day volume known only after the close
options.why: That leaks future information into earlier decisions.

options.text: Only the most profitable retrospectively selected buckets
Any later corrected feed silently substituted
options.why: Data revision/availability policy must be explicit.

items.explanation: A planning forecast and a realized benchmark are different information sets.
